variables.input:
fetch logs
| filterOut outsystems.app.name == ""
| sort outsystems.app.name asc
| summarize collectDistinct(outsystems.app.name)

fetch logs
| fieldsAdd strTenant=toString(outsystems.tenant.id)
| sort strTenant asc
| summarize collectDistinct(outsystems.tenant.id)

fetch logs
| fieldsAdd strTenant=toString(deployment.environment)
| sort strTenant asc
| summarize collectDistinct(deployment.environment)

0.content:
### Session size by screen
Thresholds: 🟢 Good ≤ 4000 bytes · 🟡 Fair ≤ 5000 bytes · 🔴 Bad > 5000 bytes

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "Screen"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.traditional.ss)
| summarize AvgSessionBytes = avg(toLong(outsystems.traditional.ss)), Count = count(), by: {Application = outsystems.app.name, Screen = outsystems.log.screen.name}
| fieldsAdd SessionSizeClass = if(AvgSessionBytes <= 4000, "🟢 Good", else: if(AvgSessionBytes <= 5000, "🟡 Fair", else: "🔴 Bad"))
| sort AvgSessionBytes desc
| limit 20

2.content:
### Viewstate size by screen
Thresholds: 🟢 Good ≤ 5000 bytes · 🟡 Fair ≤ 10000 bytes · 🔴 Bad > 10000 bytes

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "Screen"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.log.viewstate_bytes)
| summarize AvgViewstateBytes = avg(toLong(outsystems.log.viewstate_bytes)), Count = count(), by: {Application = outsystems.app.name, Screen = outsystems.log.screen.name}
| fieldsAdd ViewstateClass = if(AvgViewstateBytes <= 5000, "🟢 Good", else: if(AvgViewstateBytes <= 10000, "🟡 Fair", else: "🔴 Bad"))
| sort AvgViewstateBytes desc
| limit 20

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "Screen"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)

6.content:
### Session & viewstate size over time
Watch for upward drift — the classic "why did this app get slower" culprit

7.query:
fetch logs
| filter outsystems.log.type == "Screen"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| makeTimeseries AvgSessionBytes = avg(toLong(outsystems.traditional.ss)), AvgViewstateBytes = avg(toLong(outsystems.log.viewstate_bytes)), time: timestamp
